heroSubtitle: Lasuarindo Group presents an integrated business ecosystem driving growth, innovation, and real impact across Indonesia's strategic sectors.

intro.heading: Six Business Lines, One Ecosystem
intro.body: Lasuarindo Group invests in, owns, and manages businesses across six business lines, from investment and property to technology, media, F&B, and lifestyle. We develop each unit within one ecosystem at the T46 district in Bandung.

sectorsDesc: Our portfolio is made up of six business sectors. Each has its own role and contributes to the group ecosystem as a whole.
propertyHeading: DEVELOPING SPACES FOR A BETTER LIFE
propertyDesc: We develop high-quality properties with modern architectural design, strategic locations, and ever-growing investment value. From residential housing to large-scale commercial projects, every project is designed to provide the highest comfort and satisfaction.

propertyFeatures.desc: Comprehensive planning for modern residential areas.

propertyFeatures.title: Design & Construction
propertyFeatures.desc: Innovative architecture with the highest quality standards.

techDesc: Lasuarindo Group builds a strong digital foundation through cutting-edge technology services. From software development to cloud infrastructure, we deliver smart, secure, and sustainable solutions to drive your business digital transformation.
